notes: Site: SAP Commerce Cloud (Spartacus/Angular) storefront, nitori-net.jp/ec/. Checked: main nav (SPA shell, minimal SSR markup), robots.txt (no Claude-specific disallow, confirmed in prior-pass notes), ecstatic/sitemap/sitemap.xml index -> sitemap_content_1.xml (only lists /ec/ranking/ and /ec/outlet/ as dedicated content hubs, no explicit New Arrivals sitemap entry). Guessed and confirmed a direct URL /ec/new/ (200) which, once rendered, has canonical https://www.nitori-net.jp/ec/new/, page title/H1 '新着商品' (New Arrivals / Newly Arrived Products) with an on-page item count '749件' (749 items), and its embedded SSR state (script#nitoristore-state productSearch) shows currentQuery.query.value=':relevance:isNew:true' and pagination.totalResults=749 -- i.e. this is the site's own first-party 'isNew' catalog facet exposed as a clean canonical URL/page, not an arbitrary keyword search. This is a single flat New Arrivals listing (not split into a genuine site-defined sub-taxonomy); the left-rail facets shown on the page (category, color, price, etc.) are ordinary in-listing filters, not separate New Arrivals sub-pages, so no grouping/children rows were created for those per brief guidance against inventing sub-categories from generic filters. Sort options on the page include '新着順' (newest-first) confirming the site itself frames this listing around recency/new-arrival status. No other New-Arrivals-named page or nav item was found; local-language terms considered: 新着 (new arrivals - matched), 新商品 (new products), 新作 (new designs).

rows.evidence: Rendered page heading '新着商品' with on-page count '749件'; SSR JSON script#nitoristore-state productSearch.pagination.totalResults=749, currentQuery.query.value=':relevance:isNew:true'
